_comment: Summaries shown on brand page banners, keyed by brand name (spaces and punctuation don't matter). A summary written on the admin page (Catalog > Banner) wins over this file. Brands not listed get one built from their categories. Keep them to what the brand actually makes; no claims the brand doesn't make itself.

brands.MagnaFlow: MagnaFlow builds stainless steel performance exhaust systems, mufflers and catalytic converters for cars, trucks and Jeeps. Their cat-back and axle-back systems are made to bolt on and tuned for a deep, clean sound without the drone.
brands.ReadyLift: ReadyLift makes leveling kits, lift kits and suspension systems for trucks, Jeeps and SUVs. Their kits are engineered to keep a factory-like ride while giving you the stance and clearance for bigger tires.
brands.Mickey Thompson: Mickey Thompson has built tires and wheels for racing and off-road for decades, from drag slicks to the Baja line of mud and all-terrain tires. Shop Mickey Thompson tires and wheels built for traction on the street, strip and trail.
brands.Air Lift: Air Lift makes air suspension and load support for towing, hauling and performance. Their air spring kits and complete air ride systems level heavy loads and let you dial in ride height and comfort.
brands.Air Lift Performance: Air Lift Performance builds air suspension for cars and trucks that want an adjustable stance without giving up the drive. Adjust ride height on the fly with their struts, management systems and complete kits.
brands.AutoMeter: AutoMeter is a name racers have trusted for gauges and instrumentation since the 1950s. Shop AutoMeter tachometers, speedometers, pressure and temperature gauges and gauge pods to keep an eye on what your engine is doing.
brands.BBK Performance Parts: BBK Performance Parts builds bolt-on power for Ford, GM and Mopar vehicles. Shop BBK headers, throttle bodies, cold air intakes and exhaust parts made to fit right and add performance.
brands.Bilstein: Bilstein is a German maker of monotube shocks, struts and coilovers used by automakers and racers alike. Shop Bilstein dampers for a firmer, more controlled ride on the street, trail or track.
brands.Borla: Borla builds stainless steel performance exhaust systems known for their sound and craftsmanship. Shop Borla cat-back, axle-back and header-back systems for cars, trucks and Jeeps.
brands.Diode Dynamics: Diode Dynamics designs LED lighting in the USA: headlight and fog light upgrades, off-road pods, light bars and interior bulbs. Shop Diode Dynamics for brighter, cleaner light on the road and trail.
brands.EBC Brakes: EBC Brakes makes brake pads, rotors and kits for street cars, trucks and race cars. Shop EBC's color-coded pad compounds and slotted and drilled rotors to match how you drive.
brands.FOX: FOX builds performance shocks and suspension for trucks, Jeeps, UTVs and race vehicles. Shop FOX shocks, coilovers and remote reservoir dampers made to handle rough terrain and heavy use.
brands.Liqui Moly: Liqui Moly is a German maker of motor oils, additives and car care products. Shop Liqui Moly engine oils, fuel system cleaners and treatments to keep your engine running clean.
brands.Mahle Motorsport: MAHLE Motorsport makes pistons, rings and engine components for racing and high-performance builds. Shop MAHLE forged pistons and engine parts built to handle serious power.
brands.MBRP: MBRP builds exhaust systems for trucks, Jeeps, cars, UTVs and snowmobiles. Shop MBRP cat-back and filter-back systems in aluminized and stainless steel for sound and performance.
brands.McLeod: McLeod Racing makes clutches, flywheels and hydraulic release bearings for street and race cars. Shop McLeod clutch kits built to hold the power your engine makes.
brands.Oracle Lighting: Oracle Lighting makes innovative LED lighting for cars, trucks and Jeeps. Shop Oracle illuminated emblems, LED mirror lights, headlights and accent lighting to upgrade your style and visibility.
brands.BAK: BAKFlip tonneau covers from BAK fold up and out of the way while protecting your truck bed. Shop BAK hard folding covers built for security, weather protection and easy access.
brands.Vibrant Performance: Vibrant Performance makes the fabrication parts builders reach for: intercoolers, tubing, couplers, clamps, flanges and fittings. Shop Vibrant for custom intake, turbo and exhaust work.
brands.Gibson Performance: Gibson Performance Exhaust builds cat-back and header-back exhaust systems for trucks, SUVs, Jeeps and cars. Shop Gibson systems made for a bold sound and a clean, bolt-on install.
brands.Hawk Performance: Hawk Performance makes brake pads and rotors for street, truck and racing use. Shop Hawk pad compounds made for strong, consistent stopping power.
brands.Hotchkis: Hotchkis Sport Suspension builds sway bars, springs, control arms and complete handling kits for muscle cars, trucks and street cars. Shop Hotchkis parts made to make your car corner flatter and handle better.
brands.Husky Liners: Husky Liners makes custom-fit floor liners, mud guards and cargo liners for trucks, SUVs and cars. Shop Husky Liners to protect your interior from mud, snow and spills.
brands.ICON Alloys: ICON Alloys makes off-road wheels for trucks, Jeeps and SUVs. Shop ICON wheels designed to match their suspension systems and stand up to the trail.
brands.ICON Vehicle Dynamics: ICON Vehicle Dynamics builds off-road suspension systems, coilovers and shocks for trucks, Jeeps and SUVs. Shop ICON for suspension engineered for both trail performance and a better daily ride.
brands.Dynomax: Dynomax makes performance mufflers and exhaust systems for cars and trucks. Shop Dynomax for a deeper exhaust note and better flow.
brands.Fastway Trailer: Fastway makes towing products, including the e2 and Flip hitches and anti-sway systems. Shop Fastway towing gear for safer, more controlled towing.
brands.Granatelli Motor Sports: Granatelli Motor Sports makes ignition, sensor and performance parts for cars and trucks. Shop Granatelli for bolt-on upgrades that help your engine run stronger.
brands.KC HiLiTES: KC HiLiTES has built off-road lights since 1970. Shop KC LED light bars, pods and driving lights for trucks, Jeeps and UTVs.
brands.Mishimoto: Mishimoto makes cooling and performance parts: aluminum radiators, intercoolers, oil coolers, hoses and intakes. Shop Mishimoto to keep your engine cool under load.
brands.Motul: Motul is a French maker of motor oils and lubricants for cars, motorcycles and racing. Shop Motul engine oils, brake fluids and additives trusted on the track and on the street.
brands.Nitrous Express: Nitrous Express makes nitrous oxide systems and parts for street cars, trucks and race cars. Shop NX kits, bottles and accessories for an easy boost in power.
brands.OE Wheels: OE Wheels makes replica wheels styled after factory designs for cars, trucks and SUVs. Shop OE Wheels for an OEM look at an aftermarket price.
brands.Road Ready Wheels: Road Ready Wheels makes wheels for trucks, SUVs and cars. Shop Road Ready for a fresh look and a solid fit.
brands.Top Street Performance: Top Street Performance makes engine dress-up, cooling, fuel and ignition parts for classic and street cars. Shop TSP for hot rod and muscle car builds.
brands.Snow Performance: Snow Performance makes water-methanol injection kits for gas and diesel engines. Shop Snow for kits that help cut intake temperatures and support more boost.
brands.Trans-Dapt Performance: Trans-Dapt Performance makes engine dress-up, adapters, fittings and installation parts for engine swaps and builds. Shop Trans-Dapt for the small parts that finish a build.
brands.Truck Covers USA: Truck Covers USA makes the American Roll Cover and other retractable tonneau covers for pickups. Shop Truck Covers USA for strong, lockable bed covers.
brands.US Speedo: US Speedo makes custom gauge faces and instrument cluster upgrades for trucks and cars. Shop US Speedo to give your dash a fresh, custom look.
brands.Stifflers: Stifflers makes chassis and suspension parts for trucks and muscle cars, including transmission crossmembers, torque arms and chassis braces. Shop Stifflers for a stronger, stiffer chassis.
brands.AlphaRex: AlphaRex designs premium aftermarket lighting with bold, modern styling. Shop AlphaRex LED and projector headlights and tail lights for trucks, SUVs and cars.
brands.Baja Designs: Baja Designs builds race-proven LED off-road lighting. Shop Baja Designs LED light bars, pods and fog lights for trucks, Jeeps, UTVs and motorcycles.
brands.BMR Suspension: BMR Suspension makes suspension and chassis parts for Mustangs, Camaros, GM and Mopar muscle cars. Shop BMR control arms, sway bars and chassis braces made in the USA.
brands.BOOSTane: BOOSTane makes octane boosters and fuel additives for street and race engines. Shop BOOSTane to raise octane and protect your engine.
brands.Black Horse Off Road: Black Horse Off Road makes bumpers, grille guards, running boards, steps and bed racks for trucks, Jeeps and SUVs. Shop Black Horse for tough exterior armor and accessories.
brands.Bully Dog: Bully Dog makes performance tuners, monitors and gauges for gas and diesel trucks. Shop Bully Dog to tune for power and keep an eye on your engine.
brands.Cali Raised: Cali Raised LED makes off-road lighting, light bars and mounting brackets for trucks, Jeeps and Toyotas. Shop Cali Raised for vehicle-specific light mounts and LED setups.
brands.Carr: CARR makes running boards, side steps and hoop steps for trucks, SUVs and Jeeps. Shop CARR steps for easy access to your cab and bed.
brands.Champion: Champion has made spark plugs for more than a century. Shop Champion spark plugs and ignition parts for cars, trucks and small engines.
brands.King Engine Bearings: King Engine Bearings makes main and rod bearings for street and racing engines. Shop King bearings built to hold up under high load and RPM.
brands.Powerhouse Products: Powerhouse Products makes engine building tools and accessories for racers and engine builders. Shop Powerhouse for the tools that make a build go right.
brands.Race Sport: Race Sport Lighting makes LED and HID lighting for cars, trucks and off-road vehicles. Shop Race Sport light bars, bulbs and accent lighting.
brands.Rancho: Rancho has built off-road suspension for decades. Shop Rancho shocks, lift kits and steering stabilizers for trucks, Jeeps and SUVs.
brands.BackRack: BackRack makes headache racks, light brackets and toolbox mounts for pickup trucks. Shop BackRack to protect your cab and add mounting space without drilling.
brands.Ridetech: Ridetech builds coilovers, air suspension and complete chassis systems for classic and modern muscle cars and trucks. Shop Ridetech for a better ride and sharper handling.
brands.RIGID Industries: RIGID Industries makes LED lighting for off-road, work and marine use. Shop RIGID light bars, pods and spot lights built tough and made in the USA.
brands.Rubicon Express: Rubicon Express makes lift kits and suspension parts for Jeeps and trucks. Shop Rubicon Express for long arm kits, coil springs and control arms built for the trail.
brands.Zex: ZEX makes nitrous oxide systems and accessories for street cars and trucks. Shop ZEX kits for a simple, safe way to add horsepower.
brands.Anzo: ANZO USA makes aftermarket lighting and exterior accessories for cars, trucks and Jeeps. Shop ANZO LED headlights, tail lights and third brake lights.
brands.Coker Tire: Coker Tire makes vintage, classic and collector tires and wheels, including bias ply and radial whitewalls. Shop Coker to give your classic car the right look.
brands.COMP Cams: COMP Cams makes camshafts, lifters, rocker arms and valve train parts for street and race engines. Shop COMP Cams to wake up your engine.
brands.TCI: TCI Automotive makes automatic transmissions, torque converters and shifters for street and racing. Shop TCI drivetrain parts built to handle extra power.
brands.Edelbrock: Edelbrock makes intake manifolds, carburetors, cylinder heads and superchargers for classic and modern V8s. Shop Edelbrock parts made in the USA.
brands.FAST: FAST (Fuel Air Spark Technology) makes EFI systems, intake manifolds, ignition and fuel injectors. Shop FAST for modern fuel injection and engine management.
brands.Russell: Russell makes brake lines, fuel hoses, fittings and adapters for street and race cars. Shop Russell for the plumbing that keeps your fluids where they belong.
brands.Crown Automotive: Crown Automotive makes replacement parts for Jeeps, from engine and drivetrain parts to body panels and trim. Shop Crown to keep your Jeep running and looking right.
brands.Body Armor 4x4: Body Armor 4x4 builds bumpers, rock sliders, roof racks and armor for Jeeps, trucks and SUVs. Shop Body Armor for tough steel protection built for the trail.
brands.American Modified: American Modified makes wheels and off-road accessories for Jeeps and trucks. Shop American Modified for bold styling at a value price.
brands.BFGoodrich: BFGoodrich makes all-terrain, mud-terrain and performance tires, including the well-known T/A KO2. Shop BFGoodrich tires made for traction on the road and off it.
brands.AMP Tires: AMP Tires makes all-terrain and mud-terrain tires for trucks, Jeeps and SUVs. Shop AMP for aggressive tread and off-road traction.
brands.Lucas Oil: Lucas Oil makes motor oils, oil stabilizers, fuel treatments and additives for cars, trucks and race engines. Shop Lucas to protect your engine and keep it running smooth.
